name: Federal Pacific Group (Federal Pacific Insurance)
note: Regional insurer founded in Apia in 1999; offices in Samoa, Tonga, Cook Islands, Timor-Leste and Vanuatu, support office in Auckland, NZ. The group describes itself as privately owned; its own site and Cook Islands News name founder Alistair Hutchison (died before July 2024) and chairman, his son Papalii Alan Hutchison. No corporate register is publicly searchable for Samoa, so shareholdings are not documented.
